title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Post purchase invoices for drop shipments independently of related sales invoices
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) allows you to post purchase invoices for drop shipments independently of related sales invoices. Previously, you could not invoice a drop shipment purchase order until the associated sales order had been invoiced. This change simplifies the workflow for drop shipment scenarios.
key_points: Drop shipment purchase invoices can now be posted before the related sales order invoices are posted
You can post the invoice directly from a purchase order or by using the Get receipt lines action
This change removes certain posting logic checks that previously blocked purchase invoice posting for drop shipments

Customizations relying on removed events (OnCheckAssocOrderLinesOnBeforeCheckOrderLine, OnBeforeCheckAssociatedSalesOrderLine, OnBeforeVerifyInvoicedQty, OnVerifyInvoicedQtyOnAfterGetSalesShipmentHeader) must be reviewed and adjusted
features: Post purchase invoices for drop shipments independently
Drop shipment marking on sales orders
Create Purchase Orders from drop shipments

quotes.text: You can post invoices for drop shipment purchase orders, even if you haven't invoiced the related sales order.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core new capability that improves workflow flexibility for drop shipment scenarios
